items.name: shift
items.signature: fn shift(array: &dyn Array, offset: i64) -> Result<arrow_array::ArrayRef, arrow_schema::ArrowError>
items.summary: Shifts array by defined number of items (to left or right) A positive value for `offset` shifts the array to the right a negative value shifts the array to the left. # Examples ``` # use arrow_array::Int32Array; # use arrow_select::window:…
